text: The heart research on DMSO is only in animals and lab dishes so far, but it leans the same way. In rats given DMSO before a heart attack, about three quarters less heart muscle died than in rats without it. Most heart attacks come from a clot blocking an artery, and DMSO slowed clotting too, including in human platelets.
reader: a friend whose companion on a drug has chest pain, deciding whether DMSO with magnesium chloride on the chest is worth using before the next paragraph tells them when to call medics

question_text.Q1: Why am I reading this sentence, and do I know it before I have to work through it? (the point first, in each sentence and each paragraph; a study after the question it answers; a term explained where it is first used, never in a sentence after it)
